title: The Little Hedgehog's Prickly Hug: You Are Special!

lines.text: Hattie the little hedgehog looked sadly at her forest friends playing in the clearing!
lines.caps: Hattie the little hedgehog looked *SADLY | at her forest friends playing in the *CLEARING!

lines.text: Bunnies had silky fur and puppies had soft paws, but Hattie was covered in stiff quills!
lines.caps: Bunnies had silky fur and puppies had soft *PAWS, | but Hattie was covered in stiff *QUILLS!

lines.text: Why can't I be soft and fluffy like everyone else? she sighed to herself!
lines.caps: Why can't I be soft and fluffy like everyone *ELSE? | she sighed to *HERSELF!

lines.text: Suddenly, a giant red apple broke loose from the hilltop tree and rolled down fast!
lines.caps: Suddenly, a giant red apple broke loose from the *HILLTOP | tree and rolled down *FAST!

lines.text: It bounced straight toward the baby ducks splashing peacefully in the pond!
lines.caps: It bounced straight toward the baby ducks *SPLASHING | peacefully in the *POND!

lines.text: Hattie curled into a brave spiky ball and rolled directly into the giant runaway apple!
lines.caps: Hattie curled into a brave spiky *BALL | and rolled directly into the giant runaway *APPLE!

lines.text: THUMP! Her sturdy quills pinned the apple instantly, saving all the ducklings!
lines.caps: *THUMP! Her sturdy quills pinned the apple *INSTANTLY, | saving all the *DUCKLINGS!

lines.text: What makes you different isn't a mistake—it's your one-of-a-kind superpower!
lines.caps: What makes you different isn't a *MISTAKE— | it's your one-of-a-kind *SUPERPOWER!

lines.text: Celebrate being yourself and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
